python3 - <<'EOF'
import zipfile,re,glob
z=zipfile.ZipFile("output/offer_letter_filled.docx")
txt=""
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith(".xml"):
        txt+=z.read(n).decode("utf-8","ignore")
plain=re.sub(r"<[^>]+>","",txt)
print("unresolved {{ or }}:", bool(re.search(r"\{\{|\}\}", plain)))
print("IF_RELOCATION / END_IF markers remain:", ("IF_RELOCATION" in plain) or ("END_IF" in plain))
print("RELOCATION_AMOUNT 4,125 present (conditional kept):", "4,125" in plain)
print("Tomás Wu present:", "Tomás Wu" in plain)
print("ALDER-4210 present:", "ALDER-4210" in plain)

EOF

python3 - <<'EOF'
